title: radius: More FreeRADIUS updates
description:
Separate out the illegal motorola attributes as FreeRADIUS does into
a different dictionary, commented out in the dictionary file.

Update the FreeRADIUS (non-internal) dictionary and unwrap the sub-TLVs.
Unwrap some other sub-TLVs inside sub-TLVs since #7050 is fixed now.

Use combo-ip (which we supported due to wimax) for 3GPP2's similar
attribute.

Some other minor changes (match case, add END-VENDOR tag.)

This finishes updating the FreeRADIUS dictionaries and adding the
copyright lines. There's still some slight work to do to be able to
use the dictionaries as-is and to support some rare types.

Fix #15458.

added 3 commits
  • 88a3dc1e...48ea9d8d - 2 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • fcbc3903 - radius: More FreeRADIUS updates
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/16207/diffs?diff_id=1051518985&start_sha=88a3dc1e9743f0b23a9d26f91ab2a70c4e8041f0)

Test to see if notifications go out after merge.  
Is Radius updated often enough that there should be a tool to catch this?  
  

`TShark (Wireshark) 4.3.0rc1-267-geaa7fba6d418 (v4.3.0rc1-267-geaa7fba6d418).`
```
Could not open file: 'C:\Program Files\Wireshark\radius\dictionary.infinera', error: No such file or directory
Could not open file: 'C:\Program Files\Wireshark\radius\dictionary.mellanox', error: No such file or directory
Could not open file: 'C:\Program Files\Wireshark\radius\dictionary.mimosa', error: No such file or directory
Could not open file: 'C:\Program Files\Wireshark\radius\dictionary.rcntec', error: No such file or directory
```

Did that happen after doing a rebuild in an existing build tree? There's something where when you copy a globbed set of files with CMake it doesn't always notice that new files are there. It should work in a fresh build, or removing the CMake cache.

The GLOB change to CMakeLists.txt (40da1d487563deb1dd4a6679e364d09126f84545) is supposed to catch that, but CMake did warn that it might not work on all OSes.
It was a download from https://www.wireshark.org/download/automated/win64/ on Monday.
We might be able to use a different CMake command instead to copy the whole directory.
Do they need to be added to the `.nsi` and `dictionary` files like `motorola.illegal` was?
Ah, yes, must have missed that one, thanks.

commits_data.title: radius: More FreeRADIUS updates
commits_data.message:
radius: More FreeRADIUS updates

Separate out the illegal motorola attributes as FreeRADIUS does into
a different dictionary, commented out in the dictionary file.

Update the FreeRADIUS (non-internal) dictionary and unwrap the sub-TLVs.
Unwrap some other sub-TLVs inside sub-TLVs since #7050 is fixed now.

Use combo-ip (which we supported due to wimax) for 3GPP2's similar
attribute.

Some other minor changes (match case, add END-VENDOR tag.)

This finishes updating the FreeRADIUS dictionaries and adding the
copyright lines. There's still some slight work to do to be able to
use the dictionaries as-is and to support some rare types.

Fix #15458.
